verses.name: كولوسي 3:1
verses.text: فَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ قَدْ قُمْتُمْ مَعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ فَٱطْلُبُوا مَا فَوْقُ، حَيْثُ ٱلْمَسِيحُ جَالِسٌ عَنْ يَمِينِ ٱللهِ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:2
verses.text: ٱهْتَمُّوا بِمَا فَوْقُ لَا بِمَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ،

verses.name: كولوسي 3:3
verses.text: لِأَنَّكُمْ قَدْ مُتُّمْ وَحَيَاتُكُمْ مُسْتَتِرَةٌ مَعَ ٱلْمَسِيحِ فِي ٱللهِ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:4
verses.text: مَتَى أُظْهِرَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ حَيَاتُنَا، فَحِينَئِذٍ تُظْهَرُونَ أَنْتُمْ أَيْضًا مَعَهُ فِي ٱلْمَجْدِ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:5
verses.text: فَأَمِيتُوا أَعْضَاءَكُمُ ٱلَّتِي عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ: ٱلزِّنَا، ٱلنَّجَاسَةَ، ٱلْهَوَى، ٱلشَّهْوَةَ ٱلرَّدِيَّةَ، ٱلطَّمَعَ -ٱلَّذِي هُوَ عِبَادَةُ ٱلْأَوْثَانِ-

verses.name: كولوسي 3:6
verses.text: ٱلْأُمُورَ ٱلَّتِي مِنْ أَجْلِهَا يَأْتِي غَضَبُ ٱللهِ عَلَى أَبْنَاءِ ٱلْمَعْصِيَةِ،

verses.name: كولوسي 3:7
verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَنْتُمْ أَيْضًا سَلَكْتُمْ قَبْلًا، حِينَ كُنْتُمْ تَعِيشُونَ فِيهَا.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:8
verses.text: وَأَمَّا ٱلْآنَ فَٱطْرَحُوا عَنْكُمْ أَنْتُمْ أَيْضًا ٱلْكُلَّ: ٱلْغَضَبَ، ٱلسَّخَطَ، ٱلْخُبْثَ، ٱلتَّجْدِيفَ، ٱلْكَلَامَ ٱلْقَبِيحَ مِنْ أَفْوَاهِكُمْ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:9
verses.text: لَا تَكْذِبُوا بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ، إِذْ خَلَعْتُمُ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ ٱلْعَتِيقَ مَعَ أَعْمَالِهِ،

verses.name: كولوسي 3:10
verses.text: وَلَبِسْتُمُ ٱلْجَدِيدَ ٱلَّذِي يَتَجَدَّدُ لِلْمَعْرِفَةِ حَسَبَ صُورَةِ خَالِقِهِ،

verses.name: كولوسي 3:11
verses.text: حَيْثُ لَيْسَ يُونَانِيٌّ وَيَهُودِيٌّ، خِتَانٌ وَغُرْلَةٌ، بَرْبَرِيٌّ سِكِّيثِيٌّ، عَبْدٌ حُرٌّ، بَلِ ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱلْكُلُّ وَفِي ٱلْكُلِّ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:12
verses.text: فَٱلْبَسُوا كَمُخْتَارِي ٱللهِ ٱلْقِدِّيسِينَ ٱلْمَحْبُوبِينَ أَحْشَاءَ رَأْفَاتٍ، وَلُطْفًا، وَتَوَاضُعًا، وَوَدَاعَةً، وَطُولَ أَنَاةٍ،

verses.name: كولوسي 3:13
verses.text: مُحْتَمِلِينَ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا، وَمُسَامِحِينَ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا. إِنْ كَانَ لِأَحَدٍ عَلَى أَحَدٍ شَكْوَى، كَمَا غَفَرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْمَسِيحُ هَكَذَا أَنْتُمْ أَيْضًا.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:14
verses.text: وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ هَذِهِ ٱلْبَسُوا ٱلْمَحَبَّةَ ٱلَّتِي هِيَ رِبَاطُ ٱلْكَمَالِ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:15
verses.text: وَلْيَمْلِكْ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ سَلَامُ ٱللهِ ٱلَّذِي إِلَيْهِ دُعِيتُمْ فِي جَسَدٍ وَاحِدٍ، وَكُونُوا شَاكِرِينَ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:16
verses.text: لِتَسْكُنْ فِيكُمْ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْمَسِيحِ بِغِنًى، وَأَنْتُمْ بِكُلِّ حِكْمَةٍ مُعَلِّمُونَ وَمُنْذِرُونَ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا، بِمَزَامِيرَ وَتَسَابِيحَ وَأَغَانِيَّ رُوحِيَّةٍ، بِنِعْمَةٍ، مُتَرَنِّمِينَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ لِلرَّبِّ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:17
verses.text: وَكُلُّ مَا عَمِلْتُمْ بِقَوْلٍ أَوْ فِعْلٍ، فَٱعْمَلُوا ٱلْكُلَّ بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ يَسُوعَ، شَاكِرِينَ ٱللهَ وَٱلْآبَ بِهِ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:18
verses.text: أَيَّتُهَا ٱلنِّسَاءُ، ٱخْضَعْنَ لِرِجَالِكُنَّ كَمَا يَلِيقُ فِي ٱلرَّبِّ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:19
verses.text: أَيُّهَا ٱلرِّجَالُ، أَحِبُّوا نِسَاءَكُمْ، وَلَا تَكُونُوا قُسَاةً عَلَيْهِنَّ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:20
verses.text: أَيُّهَا ٱلْأَوْلَادُ، أَطِيعُوا وَالِدِيكُمْ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ لِأَنَّ هَذَا مَرْضِيٌّ فِي ٱلرَّبِّ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:21
verses.text: أَيُّهَا ٱلْآبَاءُ، لَا تُغِيظُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ لِئَلَّا يَفْشَلُوا.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:22
verses.text: أَيُّهَا ٱلْعَبِيدُ، أَطِيعُوا فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ سَادَتَكُمْ حَسَبَ ٱلْجَسَدِ، لَا بِخِدْمَةِ ٱلْعَيْنِ كَمَنْ يُرْضِي ٱلنَّاسَ، بَلْ بِبَسَاطَةِ ٱلْقَلْبِ، خَائِفِينَ ٱلرَّبَّ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:23
verses.text: وَكُلُّ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ، فَٱعْمَلُوا مِنَ ٱلْقَلْبِ، كَمَا لِلرَّبِّ لَيْسَ لِلنَّاسِ،

verses.name: كولوسي 3:24
verses.text: عَالِمِينَ أَنَّكُمْ مِنَ ٱلرَّبِّ سَتَأْخُذُونَ جَزَاءَ ٱلْمِيرَاثِ، لِأَنَّكُمْ تَخْدِمُونَ ٱلرَّبَّ ٱلْمَسِيحَ.

verses.name: كولوسي 3:25
verses.text: وَأَمَّا ٱلظَّالِمُ فَسَينَالُ مَا ظَلَمَ بِهِ، وَلَيْسَ مُحَابَاةٌ.

verses.name: Colossians 3:1
verses.text: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

verses.name: Colossians 3:2
verses.text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

verses.name: Colossians 3:3
verses.text: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

verses.name: Colossians 3:4
verses.text: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

verses.name: Colossians 3:5
verses.text: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

verses.name: Colossians 3:6
verses.text: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

verses.name: Colossians 3:7
verses.text: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

verses.name: Colossians 3:8
verses.text: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

verses.name: Colossians 3:9
verses.text: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

verses.name: Colossians 3:10
verses.text: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

verses.name: Colossians 3:11
verses.text: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

verses.name: Colossians 3:12
verses.text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

verses.name: Colossians 3:13
verses.text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

verses.name: Colossians 3:14
verses.text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

verses.name: Colossians 3:15
verses.text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

verses.name: Colossians 3:16
verses.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

verses.name: Colossians 3:17
verses.text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

verses.name: Colossians 3:18
verses.text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

verses.name: Colossians 3:19
verses.text: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

verses.name: Colossians 3:20
verses.text: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

verses.name: Colossians 3:21
verses.text: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

verses.name: Colossians 3:22
verses.text: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

verses.name: Colossians 3:23
verses.text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

verses.name: Colossians 3:24
verses.text: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

verses.name: Colossians 3:25
verses.text: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
